weather.blurb: The last hot one for a while. A windy front arrives overnight.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.note: Tree 3 · Grass 3 · Weed 4 · Ragweed, Elm, Grasses
pollen.blurb: Ragweed and elm and grasses are heavy today. Windows closed, meds early.

grid.blurb: A busy afternoon: demand near 74,500 megawatts, with 97,200 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 26 minutes today, and down by 6:59 p.m.
